sections.title: Quick Use
sections.body:
1. Configure your default camera, mic, and imports folder in the welcome panel.
2. Open a new project (or click continue to instrument)
3. Click on Cam A, Cam B, & Mic in the top right corner
4. Toggle Reaction Off to On in the middle of the top toolbar
5. Open the effects rack (top left corner) and select A or B
6. Hit randomise and make some noise!

sections.title: Media Sources & Queues
sections.body:
The Media & Sources toggle is in the top left, beside the Effects toggle.
You can import files and assign them to the video or audio queue in the files tab.
The sources tab allows you to use devices & applications from your computer in the video or audio channels. You can play something immediately, up next, or add it to the end of the queue.
The queues can be toggled in the top right corner underneath the camera and mic toggles. The camera and mic toggles override the queues.

sections.title: Effects Rack
sections.body:
The Effects toggle is in the top left and opens the module rack. There are 4 racks. One for each chanel, one for the transitions, and one for the entire output.

At the top of the rack is a toolbar: Randomise changes the whole rack, mutate just changes the internal module values but keeps the current modules. Options lets you you change how many modules are selected during randomise and also how much they get mutated.

Each module can be customised as granularly as you like. You can control each parameter individually, including whether it reacts to audio or not.

Modules can be grouped to appear as a single module and be easily reused or separated. 

There are a wide range of built in presets, full docs coming... eventually...

sections.title: Transitions
sections.body:
The middle of the top toolbar has the transition settings. You can set it to be static, react to different audio bands from the audio queue/mic, or transition on a constant loop. You can also drag the slider to transition between the A and B channels manually. 
You can add effects to the transition with the transition effects rack.
